source_refs.note: 'Linking Data Visuals With Hypotheses' under topic 7.5, as printed (PDF 101, printed 97).

blocks.text: Data visuals help in directly linking results with the proposed hypothesis. They allow researchers to visually check whether the data support or reject the hypothesis. For example, a comparison graph can show differences between control and experimental treatment groups. Trends in line graphs can confirm predicted outcomes. Scatter plots help identify relationships stated in the hypothesis. Visual evidence strengthens logical reasoning in hypothesis testing. Thus, data visualization provides strong support in validating or disproving hypotheses.
